cases.situation: Rosa from marketing sent a 1-hour 'brainstorm' invite for tomorrow with no agenda. I'm on the data team and figure she wants the Q3 signup numbers by channel. I'm slammed this week.
cases.reply: Hi Rosa, I'll skip the brainstorm tomorrow. If what you need from me is the signup numbers by channel for Q3, I can drop them in your doc by noon so they're there for the session. Does that cover it?
cases.note: Name what they likely need, decline the format, and give it another way with a time. No 'I'm swamped'.

cases.situation: 我是小团队的技术负责人，每周一上午有个一小时的全员周会，大部分内容跟我无关，我想退出，但发起人是老板王总。技术进展我本来每周五下班前就会更新到共享周报里。
cases.reply: 王总，想跟您商量一下：从下周开始我想不参加周一上午的全员周会了。技术这块的进展我每周五下班前会更新到共享周报里，您周一开会前就能看到。如果有议题需要我，提前说一声我就进来讲那一段。您看可以吗？
cases.note: 对上级退出例会：说清由什么替代你原来的贡献，留一个随叫随到的口子，最后请对方确认。

cases.situation: A SaaS sales rep, Kyle, has emailed me 4 times this month asking for '15 minutes' to show me their HR tool. I'm the ops manager at a 40-person company and we're not buying HR tools this year. Want him to stop.
cases.reply: Hi Kyle, thanks for following up. We're not looking at HR tools this year, so please take me off the follow-up list. If that changes, I'll get in touch.
cases.note: A clear 'not now' ends the chase faster than silence. No reason to argue with.

cases.situation: I declined my director's one-hour 'sync' on the migration plan and offered a written update instead. She replied 'I'd really prefer to talk it through live.'
cases.reply: Sure, let's do it. Could you add the one or two decisions you need from me to the invite so I come prepared? And could we keep it to 30 minutes? I'll bring the cutover timeline and the rollback plan.
cases.note: When a senior person insists, go, but shape it: ask for the decision and cap the time. Raise the format again later with evidence.

cases.situation: A founder I don't know, Arjun, messaged me on LinkedIn asking for a 30-minute call to 'pick my brain' about raising a Series A. I get a few of these every week and can't do them all.
cases.reply: Hi Arjun, thanks for reaching out, and good luck with the raise. I'm not taking calls like this at the moment, but I'm happy to help by email: send me your two most pressing questions about the Series A and I'll reply by Friday.
cases.note: Strangers asking for time: decline the call, cap the help at two questions, and give a date you can keep.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance designer. It's Tuesday, and my client Daniel just emailed at 2pm asking to 'jump on a quick call at 5 today' about the brochure, no agenda. I'm booked all afternoon on another client's work, and the brochure proofs are due to him Thursday anyway.
cases.reply: Hi Daniel, I can't do 5 today. If it's about the brochure, send me the questions or changes you have in mind and I'll reply in writing by 10am tomorrow, Wednesday. The full proofs are still on track for Thursday. If one thing truly can't wait until tomorrow, tell me what it is and I'll answer it tonight. Does that work?
cases.note: A client's same-day 'quick call' is usually habit: ask for the question, answer it in writing, and keep one narrow path open in case it really is urgent.

cases.situation: 我是项目的产品负责人。市场部的小赵约了明天周三下午两点一小时的“上线沟通会”，拉了八个人。其实现在只剩上线日期一个问题没定。
cases.reply: 小赵，明天的会能不能改成20分钟？现在只剩上线日期这一个点没定。我今晚把两个备选日期和各自的风险写成一页发到群里，大家提前看一下，会上直接定下来就行。你看可以吗？
cases.note: 作为关键参会人，缩短比拒绝更好：点明只剩哪个问题，提前把材料给出去，最后请组织者确认。

cases.situation: I'm in Singapore and our team lead Kate is in Chicago. She's put the weekly planning call at 8am Chicago every Tuesday, which is 9pm for me, and it's been two months. The US folks don't seem to notice.
cases.reply: Hi Kate, could we look at the Tuesday planning slot? 8am Chicago is 9pm here in Singapore. Two options: I put my updates and blockers in the planning doc by my end of day Monday so they're there before the call, and I join live only when something needs me; or we alternate weeks, with every other call at 7pm Chicago, which is 8am Wednesday for me. Which works better for the team?
cases.note: Time zones: name the cost once, without complaint, and give the organiser two workable alternatives rather than a bare no.

cases.situation: A peer PM, Luis, keeps booking 'quick syncs' over my Tuesday and Thursday 9 to 12 focus blocks; this one is Thursday at 10, probably for my go or no-go on the rollout flag. I'm a staff engineer, free 2 to 4 most afternoons, and I don't want to be precious about it.
cases.reply: Hi Luis, I'll skip Thursday at 10. If what you need is my go or no-go on the rollout flag, I'll post it in the channel by 5pm Wednesday. Tuesday and Thursday mornings are heads-down for me, so for anything live, 2 to 4 any afternoon works. Does that cover it?
cases.note: Decline the slot, answer the likely question in writing, and name the window that does work, once, without a speech about focus time.

cases.situation: I'm on annual leave Oct 12 to 16, booked since July. My manager Paul just sent an invite for a 'Q4 planning' session on Wednesday Oct 14. My part is the ops team's budget numbers, and my colleague Hana knows them well.
cases.reply: Hi Paul, I'm on leave that week, 12 to 16 October, so I'll miss the planning session. My part is the ops budget, so I'll put the numbers and the assumptions behind them in the planning doc by Friday 9 October, and Hana can take any questions on the day. Does that cover what you need?
cases.note: Leave is a fact, not something to defend: decline the slot, send the substance early, and name who covers.

cases.situation: I'm the finance director at a nonprofit. Helen, a program officer, has added me to a new weekly grant planning meeting, Fridays at 10 from Friday Oct 9. Our finance manager Tomás builds the grant budgets and can attend; all I need to do is sign off the final budget.
cases.reply: Hi Helen, thanks for including me. Tomás will join the Friday grant planning meetings for finance; he builds the budgets and can answer anything on the numbers. When the final budget is ready, send it to me and I'll sign it off within two working days. Does that work?
cases.note: A senior decline needs no padding: name who covers the substance, keep the one step only you can do, and give it a turnaround.

cases.situation: Ich bin Einkäufer. Herr Wagner von unserem Verpackungslieferanten will das Quartalsgespräch zu den Preisen für 2027 persönlich bei sich in Stuttgart machen, am Donnerstag, 15. Oktober: zweieinhalb Stunden Fahrt pro Richtung für eine Stunde Gespräch. Im Frühjahr fahre ich ohnehin hin, um die neue Linie abzunehmen.
cases.reply: Hallo Herr Wagner, danke für die Einladung nach Stuttgart. Das Quartalsgespräch würde ich diesmal gern per Video führen, gleicher Tag, Donnerstag, 15. Oktober, um 10 Uhr. Wenn Sie mir Ihre Preisvorschläge für 2027 bis Dienstag, 13. Oktober schicken, komme ich mit konkreten Rückmeldungen statt nur mit Fragen. Für einen Besuch vor Ort nehme ich mir gern Zeit, wenn wir im Frühjahr die neue Linie abnehmen. Passt Ihnen das?
cases.note: Das Format ablehnen, nicht die Beziehung: gleicher Termin per Video, Unterlagen vorab und ein echter Anlass für den nächsten Besuch.

cases.situation: 我是数据组的分析师。产品部小林拉了周四下午两点到四点的跨部门需求评审会，二十多人，把我也加上了。我们组的老周已经在会上负责数据口径，我只需要知道最后定了哪些埋点需求。
cases.reply: 小林，周四的评审会我就不参加了，数据这边老周会在，口径问题他都能答。会后麻烦把定下来的埋点需求发我一份，我周五中午前回复排期。你看可以吗？
cases.note: 被拉进大会只为“知会”时：说明谁已代表本组，要会后结论而不是两小时的过程，再给出自己的下一步。

cases.situation: 我是孩子班上的家委会成员，负责运动会的物资采购。家委会的陈姐约了10月17日周六上午9点到11点在学校开会，那天我要陪我妈去医院复查。其实我那部分就是一张采购清单和预算。
cases.reply: 陈姐好，17号周六上午的会我就不参加了，那天要陪家里老人去医院复查。我负责的物资采购清单和预算，16号周五晚上8点前发到群里，大家会前就能看完。会上有要改的地方直接在群里@我，我那天随时看手机回复。您看这样可以吗？
cases.note: 志愿者之间也一样：拒绝的是开会这个形式，把自己负责的那部分提前交出来，再留一个找得到你的方式。

cases.situation: 我是设计公司的项目经理，在给客户做官网改版。客户方的刘总希望从下周起每周一上午9点开一小时进度会，双方拉六个人。其实大部分进度一份周报就能说清，但我不想让他觉得我们在躲。
cases.reply: 刘总好，每周同步进度我们完全赞成，想跟您商量一个更省大家时间的方式：每周五下午5点前，我把本周进度、下周计划和需要您拍板的事整理成一页周报发给您；周一的会改成隔周一次、30分钟，只讨论周报里需要决定的事。下周一10月5日上午9点照常开第一次会，把这个节奏一起定下来。您看这样可以吗？
cases.note: 对客户不直接拒会：先认同他要的是掌握进度，用周报加更短更少的会替代，第一次会照开。

cases.situation: I teach Year 10 English. A parent, Mr. Doyle, emailed asking to meet in person this week about why his daughter Freya got a B on her essay. My marking comments already flag the two things that kept it from an A, and parents' evening is on Thursday 15 October anyway.
cases.reply: Dear Mr. Doyle, thank you for getting in touch. I think what you'd like is to understand what separated Freya's essay from an A. I'll email you a short note by Friday 2 October with the two things that made the difference and what she can focus on in her next essay. If you'd still like to talk it through after that, I'd be glad to at parents' evening on Thursday 15 October. Does that work for you?
cases.note: With parents, answer the real question in writing first, so the scheduled evening is a genuine yes rather than a brush-off.

cases.situation: Trabajo en una consultora en Valencia. Mi jefa de proyecto, Marta, me ha puesto en la reunión de seguimiento con el cliente del jueves 8 de octubre, de 10:00 a 11:30, pero a mí solo me toca contar el estado de las pruebas, unos diez minutos. El viernes tengo una entrega y necesito esa mañana para terminarla.
cases.reply: Hola Marta, para la reunión del jueves lo que necesitas de mí es el estado de las pruebas. ¿Te parece si lo pongo como primer punto, lo cuento en diez minutos y me salgo a las 10:15? Así llego bien a la entrega del viernes. Te mando hoy un resumen de una página por si sale alguna pregunta cuando ya no esté. ¿Te encaja?
cases.note: No rechaza la reunión, la acorta para sí: pide ir primero y deja por escrito lo que pueda surgir después.

cases.situation: I manage a team of six. My new report Nina, three weeks in, asked for a 30-minute daily check-in with me for her first two months. I want to support her, but I can't give 30 minutes every day; I can do Tuesdays and Thursdays at 9:30 for 30 minutes, and she can send quick questions in chat any time.
cases.reply: Hi Nina, I'm glad you asked, and I want you to have what you need to get up to speed. A daily half hour won't work on my side, so let's do Tuesdays and Thursdays at 9:30 for 30 minutes, starting this Thursday. In between, send me quick questions in chat any time; they don't need to wait for our slot. Does that work for you?
cases.note: When you're the senior one, decline the cadence, not the support, and give the new rhythm with a start date.

cases.situation: I leave work at 5 every day to pick my son up from daycare, which closes at 5:30, and it's on my calendar. Our product lead Owen keeps booking 'design review' at 5:30pm, and just sent another for tomorrow. My part is reviewing the checkout mockups.
cases.reply: I'm offline from 5, so I'll skip tomorrow's 5:30. I'll leave my comments on the checkout mockups in the file by 3pm, so you'll have them before the review. For future ones, could we keep them before 4:30 so I can join live?
cases.note: State the hard stop once as a fact, deliver the input anyway, then ask for one change to the pattern.

cases.situation: I'm the only data analyst supporting a 30-person sales team. Everyone else sends report requests through our request form, which I work through in order every Monday and Wednesday. Kevin, a sales lead, keeps booking 30-minute calls instead, and today sent one for Thursday at 2 about 'a quick pipeline cut'.
cases.reply: Hi Kevin, I'll skip Thursday's call. If what you need is a pipeline cut, put it in the request form with the fields and date range you want, and I'll pick it up in Monday's batch on 5 October. If it's needed sooner for a specific deal, add the deal and your date in the form and I'll tell you the same day whether I can move it up. Does that work?
cases.note: When a meeting is a way around the queue, send the request back to the queue kindly and give an honest path for real urgency.

cases.situation: I'm a senior designer on a product team of 12. From Wednesday Oct 7 I want to keep Wednesday and Friday mornings, until 12, free of meetings for design work, which means moving our two Wednesday 10am design reviews to 2pm the same day. I'll check Slack at noon on those days, and people can call me if something is truly urgent. I'm posting it in the team channel.
cases.reply: Heads up, team: from Wednesday 7 October, I'm keeping Wednesday and Friday mornings, until 12, free of meetings so I can get deep design work done. The two Wednesday 10am design reviews move to 2pm the same day, and I'll update the invites today. If you need me during those mornings, message me on Slack and I'll reply at noon; if something is truly urgent, call me. If this clashes with anything I've missed, tell me and we'll sort it.
cases.note: Protecting time before the clashes happen: announce it once, move what it displaces yourself, and say how people can still reach you.

cases.situation: 今天周三晚上9点半，部门经理张姐在工作群里说“10点拉个语音会，对一下明天给客户的报价”。我负责报价表里物流成本那部分，已经核对过一遍，现在在哄孩子睡觉，10点上不了。
cases.reply: 张姐，10点的语音我就不上了，这会儿在哄孩子睡觉。物流成本那部分我已经核对过一遍，明早8点半前把最终版和计算依据发到群里，您9点前就能看到。如果今晚一定要定，您把需要确认的数字发我，我10点半前文字回复。您看这样可以吗？
cases.note: 先给交付时间，再问一次是不是真的等不到明天；不去争下班后该不该开会。

cases.situation: 我大三，市场营销课四人小组做期末报告，组长小周说从这周起每天晚上9点开一小时线上会。我负责竞品分析，我们有个共享文档；我周一、三、五晚上在奶茶店兼职到10点，开不了会。
cases.reply: 小周，每天开会是想让大家进度对得上，这个我明白。晚上的会我就不每次都参加了，周一、三、五我兼职到10点。我负责的竞品分析，每周二、周四晚上8点前把进度更新到共享文档里，你们开会前就能看到。需要我一起讨论的话提前说一声，周二、周四晚上9点我都能上线。你看这样可以吗？
cases.note: 同学之间也一样：给出交付时间，比解释自己有多忙更管用。

cases.situation: I built our support team's ticket dashboard, and this week three different people have booked 30-minute calls with me to 'walk them through it'. The latest is Ravi from billing, tomorrow, Friday, at 2pm. I'd rather record one 10-minute walkthrough, post it in our #support-tools Slack channel by noon tomorrow, and answer questions in the thread.
cases.reply: Hi Ravi, sounds like you want to get set up on the ticket dashboard. I'll skip tomorrow's 2pm call; instead I'm recording a 10-minute walkthrough and will post it in #support-tools by noon tomorrow, Friday 2 October. If anything's still unclear after watching, drop your questions in the thread and I'll answer them there. Does that work for you?
cases.note: One recording replaces every future version of this call; send the same link to the next person who books one.

cases.situation: 青木です。取引先の印刷会社の営業、鈴木さんが、パンフレット案件の細かい確認のたびに1日3〜4回電話をかけてきて、作業がそのたびに止まってしまいます。確認事項はメールでまとめてもらえれば当日中に返信できますし、話す必要があるときは毎週火曜と木曜の16時から15分なら空いています。関係は良好なので角を立てたくありません。
cases.reply:
鈴木様
いつもお世話になっております。青木です。パンフレットの件、細かくご確認いただきありがとうございます。今後の確認事項は、お手数ですがメールでまとめてお送りいただけますでしょうか。いただいた分は当日中にお返事いたします。お電話のほうが早い内容は、毎週火曜・木曜の16時から15分ほどお時間をお取りしますので、その枠でご連絡いただけると助かります。この進め方でいかがでしょうか。
cases.note: 電話そのものを断るのではなく、メールと決まった時間枠という代わりの手段を示すと角が立ちません。
